fact: The second of the seven — a Venus-sized world where Webb ruled out a thick CO₂ atmosphere.
bio: TRAPPIST-1 c is close in size to Venus but, unlike Venus, JWST observations in 2023 suggested it lacks a dense carbon-dioxide blanket. Its study is part of the system's central question: whether planets around small, flare-prone red dwarfs can keep atmospheres at all.
